title: RngMotd
description: Can't choose which MOTD you want for your server? this mod lets you use multiple MOTDs that change as fast as you want them to!
body:
Can't choose which MOTD you want your server has? No need to worry anymore! with this mod you can set a list of MOTDs for your server that changes as fast as you want it to.

# **Commands in game**
### /reloadmotd
this command reloads the config
### /togglemotd
this command toggles whether it should update the motd or not, if you want it to stay as is then toggle it
